Perfect bbq experience
Sep 2026 • Couples
The restaurant is located 2 and 3 floors of the building, so you kind of have to know where you are going. Atmosphere is chill and relaxed, beautiful roof terrace. Food is amazing! We ate pastrami and brisket, both of them was so good and satisfying. Easily one of the best dishes we have ate in Vietnam. Special mention for the chimichurri, it was perfect! Decent wine list. Our waiter was Adam, and he did very good job making sure we had good time. :)
